info.title: Duply Universal API
info.description: Generate images and videos from reusable templates

post.description: Creates a generated image from a Duply template.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

templateId.description: The ID of the template to generate from.

formats[].description: Image output formats to generate, such as jpg, png, or thumb.

fill.description: Template element values keyed by the element name.

requestName.description: Optional identifier for the generation request.

transparent.description: Optional transparency flag used when generating png output.

variantName.description: Optional template variant name. Defaults to the oldest variant when omitted.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
